## 说明

本函数列出网上发布的FishBase和SeaLifeBase版本（rfishbase包使用的静态快照），并把其中最新的版本与本机已下载的版本进行比较。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function lists the FishBase and SeaLifeBase releases published online (the static
snapshots used by the rfishbase package) and compares the newest with the releases downloaded
on this computer.

</details>

## 用法

```r
check_fishbase_update(
  server = c("fishbase", "sealifebase"),
  data_dir = fao_data_dir(),
  quiet = FALSE
)
```

## 参数

`server`
:   "fishbase"、"sealifebase"或两者（默认）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    "fishbase", "sealifebase" or both (default).

    </details>

`data_dir`
:   下载数据的保存目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The directory where downloaded data is stored. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.

    </details>

`quiet`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE时不显示任何信息。默认为FALSE。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE, no message is printed. Default is FALSE.

    </details>

## 返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每个数据库（`server`）一行：网上最新的版本（离线时为NA）、本机已下载的最新版本、网上和本机已下载的数据表数量，以及是否有可用的更新（`update_available`：本机没有已下载的版本或网上有更新的版本时为TRUE；某个版本只下载了本包所需的数据表时，也视为最新）。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per server: newest online release (NA when
offline), newest downloaded release, number of tables online and downloaded, and whether an
update is available (`update_available`: TRUE when nothing has been downloaded or a newer
release is online; a release of which only the tables the package needs were downloaded is
up to date).

</details>
